title: Agent Events Protocol target payloads
description: Working draft portable payload contracts. com.veryfront is a publisher namespace. Select exactly one root definition using envelope.type; data has no duplicate type. Existing source schemas remain migration evidence, not this target.
x-payload-selection: Envelope type selects the x-event-type definition. The bundle itself is not a payload union.

Extensions.description: Optional producer-owned absolute URI namespaces, such as https://example.test/extensions or urn:org.example:telemetry. Each value is a JSON object; core fields remain closed. Publishing extensions still requires authorization.

ModelInput.description: Full captured model input or an explicit authorized redaction. Redaction is not missing-input recovery.

TokenUsage.description: Input/output token counts are the base counters. cacheRead and cacheWrite are subsets of input; reasoning is a subset of output. These counters are not additive charges and must not be added to input/output or total. Optional total is actually reported, not synthesized. Cross-field subset bounds are semantic conformance checks.

toolCallId.description: Exact logical tool-call occurrence that created the request, when known. Immutable; provider-local IDs do not establish this relation.

durationMs.description: Measured wall time for the stated scope: attempt dispatch to final response/error, or first call dispatch to final completion including retries and waits. Excludes preparation; omit when boundaries were not measured.

scope.description: Accounting scope. attempt requires exact envelope attemptid; call is an actual call aggregate and omits attemptid. Missing identity never selects a scope.

ModelCallUsageRecorded.title: com.veryfront.model-call.usage.recorded
ModelCallUsageRecorded.x-semantics: Reported token usage for an actual known attempt or call accounting bucket, selected by scope and linked by envelope modelcallid. Attempt scope additionally requires exact attemptid. Call aggregates and their constituent attempts are alternative accounting views and must not be added together. Unknown bucket or required counters prevents canonical publication; no provider attempt, call aggregate, total or billing value is invented.
ModelCallUsageRecorded.x-data-omission: Only declared optional fields may be omitted. Unknown required evidence is not defaulted; redaction alternatives, where present, are explicit. This is not a type-only fallback for malformed source data.

InputRequestCreated.x-data-omission: Only declared optional fields may be omitted. Unknown required evidence is not defaulted; redaction alternatives, where present, are explicit. This is not a type-only fallback for malformed source data.
